verifications.source_locator: Results: 'Fine-mapping risk variants for COVID-19 respiratory failure at the 3p21.31 locus...' section, para. 2; Fig. 5D legend
verifications.source_context: SLC6A20, which encodes a proline transporter, was expressed predominantly in AT2 cells and had low expression in other cell types (Figure 5D). Figure 5D legend: 'Expression of SLC6A20 across lung cell types, where each dot represents a nucleus. The highest expression observed was in AT2 cells.'
verifications.reason: SLC6A20 is described as a putative target gene of the 3p21.31 risk variant and its cell-type expression pattern is shown, but it is not presented as an AT2 marker nor used for lung cell-type annotation. The evidence is only cluster-enriched expression, so the dual gate is not met.

issues.description: Figure legends state that marker genes were used for cluster annotation (Figure 1B/D, Figure 1—figure supplement 2A/B), but the provided Markdown does not enumerate those marker genes, so additional annotation markers could not be verified from the main text alone.

task.paper_title: Single-cell multiomic profiling of human lungs reveals cell-type-specific and age-dynamic control of SARS-CoV2 host genes.
